original_claim_or_issue: Tacrolimus requires monitoring because clinically important nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, hyperkalemia and CYP3A-mediated interactions are recognized.
quantitative_detail: Current case does not capture incidence by indication, dose, formulation or concomitant therapy.
statistical_assessment: p-value is not the primary evidence type for a product label warning; incidence, exposure, temporality and reversibility should be extracted when used quantitatively.
applicability_limits: Prograf label is not a universal quantitative risk estimate for every tacrolimus product, transplant type or regimen.
coi_or_bias: Manufacturer label; regulatory review context.
corrected_wording: 승인 라벨은 tacrolimus 사용 시 신기능·신경학적 이상·전해질·상호작용과 약물농도 모니터링이 중요함을 뒷받침한다.
required_action: Link the current label version and section names; add indication/regimen-specific incidence only when the source provides it.

original_claim_or_issue: FDA changed the therapeutic-equivalence assessment for an Accord tacrolimus product because trough similarity did not fully address peak exposure.
quantitative_detail: v0.9.0 does not preserve exact strength/NDC, PK study design, sample size, fed/fasted condition, Cmax ratio, AUC ratio or 90% CI.
statistical_assessment: Do not use 'not statistically significant' without the exact endpoint, analysis method, estimate and confidence interval from the official record.
applicability_limits: Applies only to the named product/strength and regulatory action; not all generic tacrolimus.
coi_or_bias: Official regulatory source; low COI risk.
corrected_wording: FDA 조치는 특정 Accord 제품에 한정된 것으로, 모든 tacrolimus 제네릭의 비동등성을 의미하지 않는다. 이 사례는 trough만으로 peak exposure 차이를 놓칠 가능성을 보여주는 제품특이적 사례다.
required_action: Capture exact product identity and PK statistics from the FDA communication before external publication.

original_claim_or_issue: A product switch should trigger intensified TDM and clinical monitoring.
quantitative_detail: No controlled outcome study is linked showing that the proposed monitoring schedule prevents harm.
statistical_assessment: A recommendation cannot be validated by p-value alone; specify rationale, timing, thresholds and escalation criteria.
applicability_limits: Monitoring intensity depends on transplant organ, time since transplant, formulation, interacting drugs and local protocol.
coi_or_bias: Expert judgment may be conservative.
corrected_wording: 제품전환 시 추가 모니터링을 고려할 수 있으나, 구체적인 채혈시점과 조치는 이식유형·병용약·환자상태·현지 프로토콜에 맞춰 독성·이식 전문가가 확정해야 한다.
required_action: Label as recommendation, not established outcome evidence; define protocol owner and stopping/escalation rules.

original_claim_or_issue: CYP3A5 genotype can inform tacrolimus starting dose, but TDM remains necessary.
quantitative_detail: The case should capture the 1.5–2-fold starting-dose recommendation and dose ceiling only with the guideline's phenotype and clinical conditions.
statistical_assessment: Guideline recommendation is not a model-performance estimate; p-value is not the primary criterion.
applicability_limits: Does not validate an AI model, azole co-therapy rule or every transplant population.
coi_or_bias: Guideline authorship and evidence review are disclosed in the publication.
corrected_wording: CYP3A5 결과는 일부 환자의 시작용량 설정을 보조할 수 있으나, 이후 용량은 반드시 TDM과 임상상태에 따라 조정한다.
required_action: Add phenotype definitions, dose ceiling, evidence level and current-guideline version.

original_claim_or_issue: An azole-aware tacrolimus dosing algorithm showed low accuracy in lung-transplant recipients.
directness: unclear because the exact study is not uniquely identified in the case
quantitative_detail: Missing article title, cohort size, center, transplant timing, azole type/dose, outcome definition, MAE/RMSE, calibration and external validation.
statistical_assessment: A p-value comparing mean predictions is insufficient; calibration, bias, absolute error and target attainment are required.
applicability_limits: Results may be center-, assay-, genotype- and regimen-specific.
coi_or_bias: Potential single-center and retrospective bias.
corrected_wording: 현재 사례문서만으로는 특정 azole 병용 용량알고리즘의 정확도가 낮았다는 주장을 독립적으로 확인할 수 없다.
required_action: Identify the exact primary paper and populate full model-validation fields before restoring the claim.

original_claim_or_issue: Use retrospective validation, then a silent prospective pilot before clinical deployment.
quantitative_detail: Requires a prespecified sample size and clinically meaningful error thresholds.
statistical_assessment: Report calibration-in-the-large, slope, MAE/RMSE, target attainment, extreme-error rate and subgroup performance; not p-value alone.
applicability_limits: Must be validated in the intended hospital, assay, transplant population and concomitant-drug setting.
coi_or_bias: Implementation and automation bias must be monitored.
corrected_wording: 실사용 전 기관별 후향 검증과 silent prospective pilot을 수행하고, TDM 대비 성능과 극단적 과대·과소예측을 확인해야 한다.
required_action: Add acceptance criteria and human-override governance.

original_claim_or_issue: A laboratory changes from immunoassay to LC-MS/MS and wants to preserve the same target range and dose algorithm.
quantitative_detail: No client paired-sample dataset or method comparison is present.
statistical_assessment: Requires paired measurements, bias with CI, Deming/Passing–Bablok or appropriate regression, Bland–Altman and decision reclassification.
applicability_limits: Method bias depends on assay platform, metabolites, hematocrit, matrix and concentration range.
coi_or_bias: Local laboratory data are required.
corrected_wording: 검사법 전환은 가상 고객상황이며, 기존 목표농도와 알고리즘을 그대로 유지할 수 있다는 사실을 전제하지 않는다.
required_action: Keep the case, but badge every product-specific statement as synthetic until local data are uploaded.

original_claim_or_issue: Recalibrate target ranges and the dosing algorithm if clinically meaningful assay bias is detected.
directness: decision recommendation dependent on local data
quantitative_detail: Define clinical decision concentrations and allowable bias prospectively.
statistical_assessment: Statistical significance of bias is not enough; assess clinical reclassification and total error.
applicability_limits: Applies only after local method comparison and clinical governance review.
coi_or_bias: Potential laboratory-method and selection bias.
corrected_wording: 의사결정 농도대에서 임상적으로 의미 있는 bias 또는 재분류가 확인되면 목표범위와 알고리즘을 재검토한다.
required_action: Add a laboratory-specific validation plan and approval owner.

original_claim_or_issue: Tirzepatide caused thyroid C-cell tumors in rodents, and human relevance is not determined.
quantitative_detail: The case summary should reproduce species, study duration, dose/exposure multiples, sex and incidence from the current label/full report.
statistical_assessment: The label may state statistical significance without exact p-values; do not invent p-values.
applicability_limits: Product-specific nonclinical finding; not a direct estimate of human risk or a class-wide estimate.
coi_or_bias: Regulatory label; underlying sponsor studies.
corrected_wording: 현행 라벨은 설치류 C-cell 종양 소견과 사람 관련성의 불확실성을 명시한다. 사람 위험을 확정하거나 배제하지 않는다.
required_action: Add exact nonclinical study design and exposure multiples from the current label version.

original_claim_or_issue: A negative rasH2 mouse study and negative genotoxicity findings reduce concern.
directness: direct product data but indirect to the rat C-cell mechanism
quantitative_detail: Current case does not explain study sensitivity, exposure coverage or why the models address different mechanisms.
statistical_assessment: Negative studies do not statistically cancel a positive study; compare biological question, power and exposure.
applicability_limits: rasH2 and genotoxicity address different hazards from receptor-mediated rat C-cell proliferation.
coi_or_bias: Sponsor studies summarized in label.
corrected_wording: rasH2와 유전독성 음성결과는 별도의 독성질문에 대한 근거이며, rat C-cell 소견을 자동으로 무효화하지 않는다.
required_action: Display each study under its own endpoint and prohibit a net 'cancellation' interpretation.

original_claim_or_issue: The rat C-cell finding is probably not relevant to humans.
quantitative_detail: No direct human mechanistic bridge, long-latency outcome study or quantitative receptor-expression comparison is captured.
statistical_assessment: Absence of a detected human signal is not proof of absence, especially for rare/latent outcomes.
applicability_limits: Species biology, receptor expression, exposure and observation duration limit inference.
coi_or_bias: Potential confirmation bias from class familiarity.
corrected_wording: 사람 관련성은 미정이다. 종간 C-cell 생물학, receptor expression, exposure 및 장기 사람자료를 함께 평가해야 한다.
required_action: Replace probability wording with an explicit Unknown Human Relevance conclusion.

original_claim_or_issue: Tirzepatide–B12 co-formulation creates a new impurity.
quantitative_detail: Missing source identity, number of samples/lots, chain of custody, method validation, peak quantitation, orthogonal structure confirmation and independent replication.
statistical_assessment: p-value is secondary; analytical identity, specificity, accuracy, precision, LOD/LOQ and reproducibility are primary.
applicability_limits: May be formulation-, compounding-, storage- and lot-specific; cannot be generalized to approved tirzepatide products.
coi_or_bias: Potential manufacturer/sponsor or litigation-related conflicts must be displayed.
corrected_wording: 일부 혼합·보관 조건에서 미확인 추가 성분이 관찰됐다는 가설 수준으로 표현해야 하며, 구조확인 전에는 '확정 불순물'로 부르지 않는다.
required_action: Downgrade to an emerging quality-signal case until independently replicated and structurally confirmed.

original_claim_or_issue: The putative impurity may create patient safety risk.
quantitative_detail: No quantified patient exposure, toxicology, immunogenicity, pharmacology or clinical outcome data are linked.
statistical_assessment: No inferential test can substitute for exposure and hazard characterization.
applicability_limits: Clinical significance depends on identity, amount, route, duration and biological activity.
coi_or_bias: High risk of alarm amplification.
corrected_wording: 현재 자료로 환자 위해를 확정할 수 없다. 먼저 물질의 정체·함량·생성경로·환자노출·생물학적 활성을 확인해야 한다.
required_action: Prevent the app from displaying High Development Concern solely from an unconfirmed analytical peak.

original_claim_or_issue: Perform independent structural confirmation, lot survey and formation-kinetics studies.
quantitative_detail: Prespecify orthogonal LC-HRMS/MS, reference-standard or NMR confirmation, validated quantitation and stability conditions.
statistical_assessment: Use confidence intervals for lot prevalence/levels when enough lots exist; p-value alone is not decisive.
applicability_limits: Must distinguish approved products, compounded products and study-prepared mixtures.
coi_or_bias: Independent laboratory selection and blinded sample coding reduce bias.
corrected_wording: 제3기관 구조확인, 정량법 검증, lot survey, 보관·혼합조건별 생성 kinetics를 우선 수행한다.
required_action: Add chain-of-custody and COI fields to the case template.

original_claim_or_issue: Tirzepatide has product-specific dual-receptor pharmacology and biased/imbalanced signaling characteristics.
quantitative_detail: Quantitative receptor potency, efficacy and assay context should be captured when comparing candidates.
statistical_assessment: Mechanistic assay statistics do not directly estimate clinical toxicity.
applicability_limits: Direct for tirzepatide; indirect for another dual or triple agonist.
coi_or_bias: Primary studies may include sponsor employees; disclose funding and affiliations.
corrected_wording: Tirzepatide의 수용체 약리와 신호특성은 제품특이적 benchmark이며, 다른 dual/triple agonist의 동일성을 의미하지 않는다.
required_action: Add receptor-by-receptor comparability fields and funding/COI metadata.

original_claim_or_issue: Tirzepatide's safety package can bridge a new dual/triple agonist.
directness: class benchmark, not a validated bridge
quantitative_detail: No product-specific comparability across sequence, receptor balance, half-life, impurities, formulation and exposure.
statistical_assessment: Cross-product inference is not established by nominal class membership or p-value.
applicability_limits: Candidate-specific CMC, pharmacology, PK and toxicity can differ materially.
coi_or_bias: Deal-team optimism may bias extrapolation.
corrected_wording: Tirzepatide 자료는 비교 기준으로 사용할 수 있지만, 신규 후보의 독성자료를 대체하거나 자동 bridging하지 않는다.
required_action: Use a comparability matrix and identify non-bridgeable dimensions before diligence conclusions.

original_claim_or_issue: A next-generation BIRC5 ASO has defined sequence, chemistry, delivery and exposure properties.
quantitative_detail: No actual sequence, chemistry, impurity profile, target homology, species cross-reactivity or exposure data are supplied.
statistical_assessment: No quantitative analysis is possible without candidate-specific data.
applicability_limits: Historical LY2181308 and general oligonucleotide guidance are indirect.
coi_or_bias: Synthetic design assumptions.
corrected_wording: ASO-301은 명시적인 가상 후보사례이며, 제품특이적 sequence·chemistry·delivery·exposure 정보가 입력되기 전에는 독성결론을 내리지 않는다.
required_action: Show a persistent Synthetic badge and disable automated reduction claims.

original_claim_or_issue: Historical LY2181308 evidence predicts the new ASO's safety and efficacy.
quantitative_detail: The new ASO may differ in sequence, backbone, sugar modification, conjugate, delivery, dose and tissue exposure.
statistical_assessment: Cross-product transfer cannot be established by statistical significance in the historical program.
applicability_limits: Product-specificity is high for sequence-dependent and chemistry-dependent effects.
coi_or_bias: Publication and sponsor bias possible.
corrected_wording: LY2181308은 질문과 모니터링 항목을 설계하는 역사적 benchmark이며, 신규 ASO의 독성·효능을 예측하는 직접근거가 아니다.
required_action: Separate class, chemistry and sequence-specific evidence in the app.

original_claim_or_issue: Run sequence off-target, human-cell, complement/coagulation/platelet, liver/kidney exposure and species-relevance work before GLP strategy.
quantitative_detail: Must be tailored to sequence, chemistry, route and intended population.
statistical_assessment: Report assay controls, exposure coverage, effect size and uncertainty; p-value alone is insufficient.
applicability_limits: Not every endpoint is mandatory for every oligonucleotide or development stage.
coi_or_bias: Guidance is draft/nonbinding and expert judgment is involved.
corrected_wording: 후보특이적 sequence·chemistry·노출정보를 바탕으로 off-target, 사람세포, 면역·응고·혈소판, 간·신장 분포와 species relevance를 단계적으로 평가한다.
required_action: Tie each recommended test to a named hazard and decision question.

original_claim_or_issue: LY2181308 showed preclinical survivin knockdown, apoptosis and xenograft antitumor activity.
quantitative_detail: Current case omits exact models, n/group, dose, exposure, effect size, variance, statistical test and replication.
statistical_assessment: p-values without effect size, exposure and model validity would be insufficient.
applicability_limits: Preclinical models do not establish clinical efficacy.
coi_or_bias: Sponsor involvement and publication selection should be disclosed.
corrected_wording: LY2181308은 사용된 전임상 모델에서 survivin 억제와 항종양 활성을 보였으나, 임상효과를 입증한 것은 아니다.
required_action: Populate a structured nonclinical table before external use.

original_claim_or_issue: First-in-human paired biopsies demonstrated approximately 20% survivin reduction and tumor distribution.
directness: direct exploratory pharmacodynamic evidence in evaluable biopsies
quantitative_detail: Exact evaluable denominator, baseline variability, paired-analysis method, confidence interval and assay reproducibility are missing from the case summary.
statistical_assessment: A nominal percent reduction or p-value does not establish a biologically sufficient target-modulation threshold.
applicability_limits: Limited patients/tumors and early-phase setting; not population-wide efficacy evidence.
coi_or_bias: Biopsy selection and missing paired samples may bias results.
corrected_wording: 평가 가능한 paired biopsy 일부에서 종양노출과 탐색적 survivin 감소가 보고됐으나, 약 20% 감소를 충분한 표적억제 또는 전체 환자군의 결과로 해석할 수 없다.
required_action: Add evaluable n, distribution of change, CI/p-value, assay CV and missing-biopsy reasons.

original_claim_or_issue: A randomized phase II study of about 154 patients did not demonstrate clinical benefit from adding LY2181308 to docetaxel/prednisone.
directness: direct randomized clinical evidence for that regimen/population
quantitative_detail: The v0.9.0 case lacks exact randomization ratio, analysis population, endpoint definitions, HR, 95% CI, p-values, multiplicity and missing-data handling.
statistical_assessment: The claim should be supported by effect estimates and CIs, not only 'not significant'.
applicability_limits: Applies to the tested CRPC population, regimen, dose and schedule.
coi_or_bias: Randomized trial reduces confounding, but sponsor and attrition details still matter.
corrected_wording: 해당 무작위 2상에서 시험된 환자군·용량·병용요법에서는 임상적 이득이 입증되지 않았다.
required_action: Insert the exact HR/CI/p-value and endpoint table from the primary paper before publication.

original_claim_or_issue: The negative phase II result proves that survivin is not a valid target.
quantitative_detail: The program does not isolate target validity from exposure, intratumoral uptake, knockdown depth/duration, schedule, patient selection and combination effects.
statistical_assessment: A negative superiority test does not identify the causal failure node.
applicability_limits: Only the tested product/regimen/population is directly addressed.
coi_or_bias: Post hoc salvage hypotheses also require caution.
corrected_wording: 이 결과는 시험된 제품·용량·병용전략에서 이득이 입증되지 않았음을 의미하며, 표적 자체의 무효를 단독으로 증명하지 않는다.
required_action: Use a causal-chain audit and label each failure hypothesis as tested, partially tested or untested.

original_claim_or_issue: LY2181308 studies reported flu-like symptoms, coagulation changes, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia and complement-related concerns.
quantitative_detail: The current case lacks event incidence, grade, dose relation, timing, reversibility, attribution and denominator.
statistical_assessment: Descriptive incidence and exposure-response are more informative than isolated p-values in small phase I cohorts.
applicability_limits: Cannot be generalized to all BIRC5 ASOs or oligonucleotide chemistries.
coi_or_bias: Early-phase, open-label attribution and small cohort bias.
corrected_wording: LY2181308에서 보고된 안전성 신호는 신규 ASO의 모니터링 질문을 만드는 제품특이적 역사자료이며, class effect로 확정하지 않는다.
required_action: Add event-level incidence/grade/dose/timing/reversibility table.

original_claim_or_issue: A reversible grade 3 liver-enzyme DLT occurred at 750 mg in a Japanese phase I study.
quantitative_detail: Case must include cohort size, number exposed at 750 mg, exact laboratory criteria, onset, recovery, rechallenge and causality assessment.
statistical_assessment: A single DLT is not interpreted by p-value; clinical context and exposure are central.
applicability_limits: Small Japanese phase I cohort, LY2181308-specific formulation and regimen.
coi_or_bias: Open-label DLT attribution and small numbers.
corrected_wording: 일본 1상에서 보고된 750 mg의 가역적 grade 3 간효소 DLT는 해당 연구의 직접자료이며, 모든 survivin ASO의 일반적 독성으로 확대하지 않는다.
required_action: Populate exact cohort and DLT details from the primary paper.

original_claim_or_issue: Monitor complement, cytokines, coagulation, platelets, lymphocytes, liver and kidney function in a new BIRC5 ASO study.
quantitative_detail: Monitoring schedule and stopping thresholds require candidate-specific chemistry, dose, infusion and exposure data.
statistical_assessment: Thresholds should be clinically justified; multiple serial tests require interpretation plans.
applicability_limits: Not a universal mandatory panel for every oligonucleotide.
coi_or_bias: Conservative monitoring may increase false alarms.
corrected_wording: 신규 ASO의 chemistry·sequence·투여경로·노출과 사전 신호에 따라 모니터링 패널과 중단기준을 맞춤 설계한다.
required_action: Connect each test to a hazard, timing, threshold and action.
